bom.notes: Quantities below count components modeled in this exact scene, not a complete shopping list. Wires, glue, spare parts and unmodeled fasteners may be missing; linked authored documents supply additional requirements. Saved design inventory records 16 brackets owned, 12 required in the design and 4 spare; this is not a claim of physical installation. Final spacer machining and exact front-receiver fastener lengths remain to be settled. v37 explicitly models twelve cap machine screws, twelve cap heat-sets and36 C-web self-tappers. Femur front screw stack is now specified; tibia and horn hardware remain inherited/measured-fit items.

instructions.title: v37: cap inserts / metal-web self-tappers
instructions.text: Print one revised servo box first; the v36 cap remains compatible. Heat-set two M3x5.7 inserts flush into the cap-facing Ø4x6.7mm bores of the empty detached box; assumes4.6mm knurled OD. Screw metal hip C web onto printed femur with six3x8 plastic self-tappers before mounting C on hip servo. Then fit knee servo and cap with twoM3x8 machine screws. No front inserts, cap self-tappers or cap nuts. Plastic thread fit/torque/pullout untested; do not overtighten. Same96mm hip-to-knee datum asv36; firmware/IK not modified.
